problem:
Let $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2}}$ be a basis of ${R}^{2}$ and let $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ be a linear transformation. Find $[T(x)]_{B}$, given that
$\,$ $[T]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}5 & -1 \\ 2 & 6\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 7\end{aligned}].$

activity_context.topic_title: The Matrix of a Linear Transformation Relative to a Basis

examples.knowledge_point: Calculating the Image of a Vector Given the Matrix of a Linear Transformation Relative to a Basis
examples.problem:
Let $\mathcal{B}=\{ \mathbf{b}_1,\mathbf{b}_2 \}$ be a basis of $\mathbb{R}^2$ and let $\mathbf{T}:\mathbb{R}^2 \rightarrow \mathbb{R}^2$ be a linear transformation. Find $[\mathbf{T}(\mathbf{x})]_{\mathcal{B}}$, given that
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14066994/assets/ce5c4a3b67cdbcb3fd7a808d201cc5dd0247408788957487d6b6898622cd0ff8.png)
examples.worked_solution:
The image of $[\mathbf{x}]_{\mathcal{B}}$ relative to the basis $\mathcal{B}$ under the action of the linear transformation $\mathbf{T}$ is given by 

$$
\begin{aligned}[T(x)]_{B} & =[T]_{B}[x]_{B} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ -2 & 5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-7 \\ 16\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
